title: Backend Systems: Invariants, Failures, Recovery
scope: Seven conceptual phases for backend reasoning, practical concurrency work and interview transfer. No prescribed calendar duration.

sources.title: Node.js: Event loop and worker pool
sources.role: Runtime ownership, blocking and bounded work

sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.role: Actual database visibility and concurrency guarantees, not generic ACID slogans

sources.title: RabbitMQ acknowledgements and confirms
sources.role: Distinguish publisher confirmation, delivery and consumer acknowledgement

sources.title: OWASP authorization guidance
sources.role: Server-side authorization, least privilege and per-request enforcement

sources.title: Redis client-side caching and invalidation
sources.role: A concrete cache-coherence mechanism to compare with the original cache-race case; not a universal cache-aside guarantee

sources.title: Stripe idempotent requests
sources.role: A concrete documented retry contract: operation identity, parameter comparison and retained results; distinguish it from general exactly-once claims

sources.title: OWASP WebSocket security
sources.role: Long-lived authentication, per-message authorization and session/revocation boundaries

sources.title: OpenTelemetry traces
sources.role: Request-path spans and causal context for latency localization; instrumentation evidence rather than guessed bottlenecks

sources.title: PostgreSQL standby and replication behaviour
sources.role: Replication, replay visibility, acknowledgement and failover trade-offs in a concrete database

units.title: Runtime, concurrency and backpressure
units.outcome: Locate execution, waiting and capacity limits in a request path.

units.title: Transactions and connection pressure
units.outcome: Protect a business invariant under concurrency and separate pool wait from query execution.

units.title: State ownership, cache visibility and replicas
units.outcome: State an explicit freshness contract and reason about stale cache publication.

units.title: Queue delivery, retries and uncertain outcomes
units.outcome: Separate transport acknowledgement from business-effect duplication safety.

units.title: Authorization and long-lived connections
units.outcome: Enforce resource access at the owner and handle permission changes over time.

units.title: Production diagnosis and architecture boundaries
units.outcome: Choose one discriminating measurement and scale the demonstrated bottleneck.

units.title: Replication, integration and interview transfer
units.outcome: Combine visibility, acknowledgement and recovery guarantees in an unfamiliar case.
